dataset.citation: Nguyễn Thành Dân (2026). ThonRetire Retirement Destination Dataset 2026, v1.3. Verified July 2026. https://thonretire.com/data — CC-BY-4.0

files.describes: One row per destination, wide. Convenience view — no per-field provenance.
One row per public fact, with its own verification date, freshness status, confidence and primary source link.
One row per city, including the gap between city cost and the country-level headline figure.
Everything above in one file, with the field dictionary and this licence embedded.
